policy: Frozen line-count ceiling for AICC's highest blast-radius hotspot files (VOYN-W0-AICC-HOTSPOT-EXTRACTION-SEAMS). A mass rewrite of these files is not wanted: every change that touches one must first pull the touched behavior into a module with an explicit interface (an extraction seam) and pin its current behavior with a characterization test before changing it -- see docs/HOTSPOT_EXTRACTION_SEAMS.md. This baseline records each file's line count at freeze time. Growing past a ceiling fails CI; shrinking (extracting code out) is always allowed and never fails the gate. Any edit to this file is a reviewed architectural decision -- see the policy doc for the procedure.
